description: This Java source file defines the WiFiDirectBroadcastReceiver class, which extends BroadcastReceiver and handles various Wi-Fi P2P (Wi-Fi Direct) related events such as state changes, peer availability, connection status, and device info updates. It interacts with other components like WiFiDirectActivity, DeviceDetailFragment, and DeviceListFragment to update the UI and manage Wi-Fi Direct connections.

classes.name: WiFiDirectBroadcastReceiver
classes.description: A BroadcastReceiver that listens for Wi-Fi P2P state changes, peer availability, connection status, and device info updates, and updates the application's UI accordingly.

methods.name: WiFiDirectBroadcastReceiver
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the receiver with the Wi-Fi P2P manager, channel, and activity.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Handles Wi-Fi P2P related broadcast events, updating UI and requesting peer and connection info as appropriate.
